# `adt ddl`

ABAP DDL source operations

```bash
adt ddl [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command            | Description                             |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------- |
| `adt ddl create`   | Create a new ABAP DDL source            |
| `adt ddl read`     | Read source code of an ABAP DDL source  |
| `adt ddl write`    | Write source code to an ABAP DDL source |
| `adt ddl activate` | Activate one or more ABAP DDL source(s) |
| `adt ddl delete`   | Delete an ABAP DDL source               |

## `adt ddl create`

Create a new ABAP DDL source

```bash
adt ddl create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description       | Default |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | DDL source name   |         |
| `<description>` | Short description |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name      |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                       | Default |
| -------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number          |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if DDL source already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                    |         |

## `adt ddl read`

Read source code of an ABAP DDL source

```bash
adt ddl read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description     | Default |
| -------- | --------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | DDL source name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

## `adt ddl write`

Write source code to an ABAP DDL source

```bash
adt ddl write [options] <name> [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                        | Default |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | DDL source name                    |         |
| `[file]` | Source file path (use - for stdin) | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `--activate`               | Activate after writing   |         |

## `adt ddl activate`

Activate one or more ABAP DDL source(s)

```bash
adt ddl activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description        | Default |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ------- |
| `<names...>` | DDL source name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt ddl delete`

Delete an ABAP DDL source

```bash
adt ddl delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description     | Default |
| -------- | --------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | DDL source name |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
